sanskrit_verse: तदन्तरा धनं दत्त्वा ऋणी बन्धमवाप्नुयात् । पूर्णे विधौ सान्तलाभे बन्धस्वामी ततो भवेत् ॥ अनिर्गते दशाहे तु ऋणी मोक्षितुमर्हति ॥
transliteration: tadantarā dhanaṃ dattvā ṛṇī bandham avāpnuyāt | pūrṇe vidhau sāntalābhe bandhasvāmī tato bhavet || anirgate daśāhe tu ṛṇī mokṣitum arhati ||
sph_interpretive_translation: Having received payment within the interim period, the debtor assumes the state of bondage. Upon full completion of the prescribed process and attainment of tranquility, ownership of the bond becomes established. If ten days pass without issuance of the bond, the debtor is entitled to release.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority derives from fulfillment of procedural integrity
Causation aligns with sequential completion of transactional stages
Capacity-based responsibility is determined by active participation in dharma-conformant exchange
Restoration logic operates through reintegration into lawful relational structures
Consciousness alignment occurs when all parties recognize mutual completion
executable_legal_axioms: IF payment_received == TRUE AND time_elapsed < 10_days THEN status = 'bondage_pending'
IF process_completed == TRUE AND tranquility_attained == TRUE THEN bond_owner = creditor
IF time_elapsed >= 10_days AND bond_not_issued == TRUE THEN debtor_status = 'released'
supreme_court_application: In adjudicating financial obligations, the Supreme Court shall assess whether procedural thresholds have been met and whether a ten-day window has elapsed without formalization. Responsibility lies not in fault but in the completion or non-completion of lawful sequence. Release is automatic upon failure to issue bond within stipulated timeframe.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality establishes that bond ownership arises only after verified completion of ritual-economic acts. Anupūrvaśaḥ ensures that temporal sequencing determines relational status. Proportional responsibility reflects capacity to complete action. There is no punitive consequence—only realignment of relational integrity based on transactional truth.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate completion verification protocol to establish factual transaction status
Engage responsibility assumption framework to restore creditor-debtor clarity
Activate capacity restoration pathway for either party showing dissonance
Execute integrity reintegration sequence upon resolution of bond status
final_declaration: By the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands declared. Dharma is restored. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness alone adjudicates.
